Context: 12. Second Mortgage.-

Employees' Group Insurance Scheme, 1980, can assign his interest in the insurance cover and accumulation in the Savings Fund as a security for  
to the financial institution for obtaining additional loan from them acquiring/building a flat/house subject to conditions 1 to 4 above.  
The communication of acceptance of the assignment should be entered in the Service Record in red ink. - Para. 13.2 of CGEGIS.
